reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, category_id, unit_cost_eur,
       ROUND(AVG(unit_cost_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id), 2) AS category_avg_cost
FROM products
WHERE category_id BETWEEN 15 AND 20
alternatives:
WITH category_avg AS (  -- one row per Audio category
  SELECT category_id, AVG(unit_cost_eur) AS avg_cost
  FROM products
  WHERE category_id BETWEEN 15 AND 20
  GROUP BY category_id
)
SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.unit_cost_eur, ROUND(ca.avg_cost, 2) AS category_avg_cost
FROM products p
JOIN category_avg ca ON ca.category_id = p.category_id

SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.unit_cost_eur,
       ROUND((SELECT AVG(p2.unit_cost_eur) FROM products p2 WHERE p2.category_id = p.category_id), 2) AS category_avg_cost
FROM products p
WHERE p.category_id BETWEEN 15 AND 20

other_way.sql:
WITH category_avg AS (  -- one row per Audio category
  SELECT category_id, AVG(unit_cost_eur) AS avg_cost
  FROM products
  WHERE category_id BETWEEN 15 AND 20
  GROUP BY category_id
)
SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.unit_cost_eur, ROUND(ca.avg_cost, 2) AS category_avg_cost
FROM products p
JOIN category_avg ca ON ca.category_id = p.category_id
other_way.tradeoff: A per-category step joined back runs on any engine, but it takes a second step and a join where the window takes one line.
